what: With the higher cut view (camM3El 38) the cut plane now enters as a wide disc. At 78.5-80 s it is clipped by the top edge of the canvas and runs over the colour legend.
why: Starting the plane at 170 instead of 230 world units keeps the whole disc inside the frame as it enters. It only changes where the plane starts; the place it stops (the equator) and the lit count stay the same.

what: The first orbit's dots count in at 14.0 s right on top of the fading plate 'Emmy Noether · 1918', so the year is overprinted by marks for about 1 s.
